provenance.author: Fedor Kuyanov
provenance.method: Exact specialization of the stabzoo arbitrary-phase product construction at w = exp(I*pi/8)

notes: chi(|sqrtT>^13) <= 54, alpha = log_2(54)/13 = 0.442683654013. Specializes the exact polynomial identity for (|0>+w|1>)^13 from stabzoo phase_product/n13_r54.json, partition 3+5+5. Set w=exp(I*pi/8), convert QlAb stabilizers to affine-support witness terms, and adjust their constant phases and support normalizations to the normalized challenge target. The source identity holds for arbitrary complex w and was checked coefficientwise on all 8192 computational amplitudes before specialization. No coefficients vanish at this phase. The provenance date is the original construction date; specialization and export were performed on 2026-11-15. The unmodified source certificate is preserved at research/constructions/data/phase_product_n13_rank54_stabzoo.json.
